t: 丹麦采用了典型的北欧十字旗，后来被所有其他斯堪的纳维亚国家所采用。
te: Denmark adopts the characteristic Nordic Cross flag later taken up by all other Scandinavian countries.
dz: 丹麦采用了典型的北欧十字旗，后来被所有其他斯堪的纳维亚国家所采用。
de: Denmark adopts the characteristic Nordic Cross flag later taken up by all other Scandinavian countries.

t: 北美第一个路德宗教派宾夕法尼亚牧师会在费城成立。
te: The first Lutheran denomination in North America, the Pennsylvania Ministerium, is founded in Philadelphia.
dz: 北美第一个路德宗教派宾夕法尼亚牧师会在费城成立。
de: The first Lutheran denomination in North America, the Pennsylvania Ministerium, is founded in Philadelphia.

t: 一英国中队在战术上战胜了哈瓦那外的一西班牙中队.
te: A British squadron wins a tactical victory over a Spanish squadron off Havana.
dz: 詹金斯耳之战:一英国中队在战术上战胜了哈瓦那外的一西班牙中队.
de: War of Jenkins' Ear: A British squadron wins a tactical victory over a Spanish squadron off Havana.

t: 签署"艾克斯-拉-查佩尔条约"结束了奥地利继承战争.
te: Signing of the Treaty of Aix-la-Chapelle ends the War of the Austrian Succession.
dz: 签署"艾克斯-拉-查佩尔条约"结束了奥地利继承战争.
